children: Capita plc entered new facilities with Shawbrook: a £15M revolving credit facility and a £15M term loan, both maturing in September 2029. The term loan rate is modestly higher than the RCF. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes and refinancing.
Adds liquidity and refinancing capacity, easing near-term funding risk.
Flexible line mirrors terms of existing £325M RCF, supporting working capital.
Term debt extends duration; rate modestly higher than RCF.
Signals rollover of obligations rather than incremental spend.
Diversifies funding sources beyond existing RCF syndicate.

This modest facility upsizing/refinance fits ongoing balance sheet management rather than a new strategic pivot. A larger refinancing, improved pricing, or debt reduction guidance would turn this into a bigger catalyst.
